title: Moments — Microevent Attention — alt equal-duration cut (no long hold)

events.label: ALT equal-duration: E1 RESISTANCE (sleeve/handle substitute): a strapped wooden skate on ice; a hand works the strap; the shod foot set back down. Source has no sound track
ALT equal-duration: E2 WATER (cup-edge substitute): fingers hover over a beaker, drop something in, water clouds and churns. Narration muted
ALT equal-duration: E3 LATCH (wait-for-click substitute): a toddler reaches up and pats a closed door, turns, waits; nothing opens. Source silent (hiss kept)
ALT equal-duration: E4 KEY / LONG HOLD: a hand holds a round knob beside a fixture for ~8 s, then fits it in and withdraws; the knob stays. Narration muted
ALT equal-duration: E5a hands break a roll at a set table; low source room/music bed (pre-narration) kept
ALT equal-duration: E5b aftermath: same table, hands gone, glass and rolls (source's own next shot). Narration muted
ALT equal-duration: E6 SETTLING (cloth substitute): a fold of skin pinched, held, released; it settles back slowly. Narration muted
ALT equal-duration: E7 a man crosses a pavement seen from above and passes under a roof; the pavement remains. Source music muted
ALT equal-duration: E8 EMPTY SPACE: a girl waves from a doorway and leaves; a man crosses; the lamp-lit room holds after both have gone. Dialogue muted
ALT equal-duration: E9 RETURN: the beaker again, its event over; source hum between narration phrases kept
